author: blu
body: The first generator in the tree carrying no ScRaw and no SeRaw. It is the proof that the DSL can hold a real script rather than a transcription of one, and the reason it was chosen first is that its drift had eaten two rulings: the -ApprovedBy parameter, without which a regeneration silently removes the stop on launching the battery, and -Jobs 8, which replaced 7 on 2026-08-02.
